evals.rule_under_test: Worktree branch names must follow the feature/<id>, bug/<slug>, or chore/<slug> convention
evals.prompt: Start a worktree for work on F002.
evals.expected_output: Skill creates a worktree on branch `feature/f002` (lowercase). Does NOT create branches like `worktree-random-name` or `wip-something`.

assertions.name: branch name uses feature/ prefix
assertions.check: Created branch name starts with 'feature/' and references F002 (or 'f002').

evals.rule_under_test: Worktree merge must trigger harness:archive via the finishing-a-development-branch chain
evals.prompt: Merge the worktree on branch feature/f002 back to main (Option 1 of finishing-a-development-branch).
evals.expected_output: After successful merge, skill invokes finishing-a-development-branch which invokes harness:archive. Both run before completion is reported.

assertions.name: finishing-a-development-branch called
assertions.check: Output references invoking finishing-a-development-branch after merge.

assertions.name: harness:archive called
assertions.check: Output references invoking harness:archive (or its sub-steps) before reporting done.
